req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug automatically percent-decodes path segments before passing them to the route handler, so the set_cookie handler receives already-decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) normal ASCII name/value sets cookie correctly (EP positive), (2) percent-encoded special characters in name/value are decoded and set correctly (EP positive with encoding), (3) percent-encoded space (%20) in name and value is decoded to a literal space (BVA), (4) a name with percent-encoded equals sign is decoded (BVA), (5) empty name or value edge cases (NEG/BVA), (6) the redirect target is exactly /cookies (STC). We drive the Flask test client in-process, follow redirects to verify the cookie appears in /cookies JSON, and assert exact values to kill mutations that alter the decoding logic, redirect target, or cookie key/value assignment.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_plain_ascii_name_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: JSON body contains cookies dict with key 'mycookie' equal to 'myvalue'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: plain ASCII name/value path segments are passed through unchanged
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_plain_ascii_name_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mycookie'] == 'myvalue'

test_set_cookie_plain_ascii_name_value()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_redirect_target_is_cookies_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: set_cookie redirects to view_cookies; redirect target must be exactly /cookies
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_redirect_target_is_cookies_endpoint():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/redir_name/redir_value', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies')
    assert 'cookies' in location
    assert 'set' not in location

test_set_cookie_redirect_target_is_cookies_endpoint()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_response_json_structure_exact
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify that a different cookie name is NOT present in the response
expected: JSON body cookies dict contains exactly 'negtest' key with value 'negval'
Key 'wrongname' is NOT present in cookies dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: negative path verifying that the decoded name is used as cookie key, not a raw or wrong value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_response_json_structure_exact():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/negtest/negval', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert isinstance(data['cookies'], dict)
    assert data['cookies'].get('negtest') == 'negval'
    assert 'wrongname' not in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies'].get('negtest') != 'wrongval'
    assert data['cookies'].get('negtest') != ''

test_set_cookie_response_json_structure_exact()
